Six markets, four ERPs

Baltics & Germany billed in EUR, Poland in PLN, Czechia in CZK — and Germany VAT-inclusive while the others are ex-VAT. Everything below is normalized to net EUR, comparable market to market.

Germany and Czechia post the weakest margins despite mid-pack revenue.

Families & SKUs

27 SKUs from the Mac line to silicone cases. Margin follows the product family, not revenue: accessories and services weigh little in revenue but carry most of the margin.

7 of 27 SKUs are in the red, all flagged legacy.

Promotions & campaigns

13 promo codes, 7 tracked marketing campaigns. Every code was used within its validity window — but some circulated outside the markets targeted by the matching campaign (see note).

WELCOME10 is 12x cheaper per euro of revenue than CLEARANCE.

Returns

3,917 raw return lines → 107 exact duplicates removed → 3,810 real returns, one per unit. The return rate below is computed on the deduplicated data.

Only damaged/faulty returns are true margin loss.

What we found while cleaning

Nine extracts, four systems, none reconciled to start. Every anomaly below was verified by recomputation (price × quantity × (1−discount) = net amount) before correction — nothing was fixed by eye.

Source data: cc_distribution.xlsx (9 sheets, 22,827 order lines + 3,917 return lines). EUR conversion via the supplied period-average rates (PLN 4.42, CZK 24.85); German VAT (19%) removed for comparability. AI tools: Claude (Anthropic) — used for data cleaning/reconciliation, analysis, and building this dashboard's code.
